q: What does a 'connected wall' mean in this course?
options: A wall of monitors in your office
One agent reached through many surfaces, sharing the same memory and skills
A group of separate, disconnected bots
explanation: A connected wall is one coherent agent — same tools, memory and skills — reached from terminal, Telegram, email, and cron.

q: How do you prove surfaces share the same agent?
options: Ask the Telegram agent to reproduce a skill you only saved on the laptop
explanation: If Telegram can call the skill you saved on your laptop, they share memory and it's truly one agent.

q: What is the recommended architecture for a personal agent?
options: A fresh separate instance for every device
One instance (often on a VPS) as the source of truth; all surfaces connect to it
Two competing agents on different devices
explanation: Run one instance as the source of truth. Separate per-device instances fragment memory and skills.

q: Which surface should you add FIRST to reach your agent from anywhere?
options: The messaging gateway, e.g. Telegram or WhatsApp
explanation: The messaging gateway is the highest-value first connection: it makes your always-on agent reachable from your phone, where you actually are.
